description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalupendigama, Balangoda D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620006
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding title to specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
